examples.title: Bitcoin Core wallet check: prove a wallet.dat opens, offline, in your browser
examples.description: Drop a wallet file, or try one of seven demo wallets: it is imported by an unmodified Bitcoin Core 31.1 running in a Linux VM emulated in the tab, with no network device. Nothing is uploaded.
examples.image_alt: Bitcoin Core wallet check: an encrypted demo wallet imported and unlocked offline, every step marked ok

title: v86_64 — 64-bit Linux in your browser
description: A virtual machine manager for x86-64 Linux distributions, emulated in WebAssembly with a 64-bit JIT. Pick an ISO and boot it in your browser: nothing to install.
image_alt: An Alpine Linux root shell running in the v86_64 browser emulator
